# Renewable Energy Cost Revolution: LCOE, Capacity & Fossil Fuel Subsidies (2010–2024)

## Overview
This collection of four datasets tracks the economic transformation of the global energy sector from 2010 to 2024. It covers the declining levelized cost of energy for solar PV, onshore wind, and battery storage; the cost range of new fossil fuel generation; cumulative renewable installed capacity; and annual global fossil fuel subsidies.

import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
from matplotlib.gridspec import GridSpec

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

lcoe = data['lcoe_trends']['data']
fossil_range = data['fossil_fuel_lcoe_range']['data']
capacity = data['installed_capacity']['data']
subsidies = data['fossil_fuel_subsidies']['data']

years_lcoe = [d['year'] for d in lcoe]
solar = [d['solar_pv'] for d in lcoe]
wind = [d['onshore_wind'] for d in lcoe]
battery = [d['battery_storage'] for d in lcoe]

years_fossil = [d['year'] for d in fossil_range]
gas_low = [d['gas_ccgt_low'] for d in fossil_range]
gas_high = [d['gas_ccgt_high'] for d in fossil_range]
coal_low = [d['coal_low'] for d in fossil_range]
coal_high = [d['coal_high'] for d in fossil_range]

years_cap = [d['year'] for d in capacity]
solar_cap = [d['solar_pv_gw'] for d in capacity]
wind_cap = [d['onshore_wind_gw'] for d in capacity]

years_sub = [d['year'] for d in subsidies]
total_sub = [d['total_subsidies_bn'] for d in subsidies]
cons_sub = [d['consumption_subsidies_bn'] for d in subsidies]
prod_sub = [d['production_subsidies_bn'] for d in subsidies]

# --- Editorial color palette ---
COL_SOLAR = '#E8871E'
COL_WIND = '#2D7D9A'
COL_BATTERY = '#8B3A8B'
COL_FOSSIL_BAND = '#B0B0B0'
COL_SUBSIDY_CONS = '#C44E52'
COL_SUBSIDY_PROD = '#E8967A'
COL_SOLAR_CAP = '#E8871E'
COL_WIND_CAP = '#2D7D9A'
BG_COLOR = '#FAFAF7'
GRID_COLOR = '#E0DDD8'
TEXT_COLOR = '#2B2B2B'
ANNOT_COLOR = '#6B2B2B'

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.facecolor': BG_COLOR,
    'figure.facecolor': BG_COLOR,
    'axes.edgecolor': '#CCCCCC',
    'axes.labelcolor': TEXT_COLOR,
    'xtick.color': TEXT_COLOR,
    'ytick.color': TEXT_COLOR,
    'text.color': TEXT_COLOR,
    'axes.grid': True,
    'grid.color': GRID_COLOR,
    'grid.alpha': 0.7,
    'grid.linewidth': 0.5,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 18))
gs = GridSpec(3, 2, figure=fig, height_ratios=[1.2, 1, 1],
              hspace=0.32, wspace=0.28, left=0.08, right=0.94, top=0.91, bottom=0.05)

# ===== Suptitle =====
fig.suptitle('The Renewable Energy Cost Revolution, 2010–2024',
             fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', y=0.97, x=0.08, ha='left',
             color=TEXT_COLOR)
fig.text(0.08, 0.945,
         'Declining clean energy costs, accelerating deployment, and the persistent scale of fossil fuel subsidies',
         fontsize=11, color='#666666', ha='left', style='italic')

# ===== PANEL A: LCOE Decline (top, spans full width) =====
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])

# Interpolate fossil range to yearly for fill
fossil_gas_low_interp = np.interp(years_lcoe, years_fossil, gas_low)
fossil_gas_high_interp = np.interp(years_lcoe, years_fossil, gas_high)
fossil_coal_low_interp = np.interp(years_lcoe, years_fossil, coal_low)
fossil_coal_high_interp = np.interp(years_lcoe, years_fossil, coal_high)

# Fossil overall band (coal_high to gas_low)
ax1.fill_between(years_lcoe, fossil_gas_low_interp, fossil_coal_high_interp,
                  alpha=0.15, color=COL_FOSSIL_BAND, label='Fossil fuel LCOE range\n(gas CCGT low – coal high)',
                  zorder=1)
ax1.plot(years_lcoe, fossil_gas_low_interp, color=COL_FOSSIL_BAND, linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
ax1.plot(years_lcoe, fossil_coal_high_interp, color=COL_FOSSIL_BAND, linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# Battery on secondary y-axis on the same plot but we'll use a break approach
# Actually, let's use log scale for LCOE panel to show battery nicely
ax1.set_yscale('log')

ax1.plot(years_lcoe, battery, color=COL_BATTERY, linewidth=2.8, marker='o', markersize=4,
         label=f'Battery Storage (4h Li-ion)', zorder=4)
ax1.plot(years_lcoe, solar, color=COL_SOLAR, linewidth=2.8, marker='s', markersize=4,
         label='Solar PV', zorder=5)
ax1.plot(years_lcoe, wind, color=COL_WIND, linewidth=2.8, marker='^', markersize=4,
         label='Onshore Wind', zorder=5)

# Annotate crossover points
# Solar crosses below coal_high (~105 in 2010, declining) — solar was 107 in 2015, 86 in 2016
# Solar crosses below gas_ccgt_high (~72-78) — solar was 72 in 2017, 60 in 2018
# Wind crosses below gas_ccgt_low (~42-55) — wind was 44 in 2019, 41 in 2020

# Solar crosses below coal high (≈2015, solar=107 vs coal_high ~97 interpolated → actually 2016 solar=86 vs coal ~96)
ax1.annotate('Solar crosses below\nnew coal cost (2016)',
             xy=(2016, 86), xytext=(2013.5, 200),
             fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color=ANNOT_COLOR,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=ANNOT_COLOR, lw=1.3),
             ha='center', zorder=10,
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FFF5EE', edgecolor=ANNOT_COLOR, alpha=0.9))

# Wind crosses below gas CCGT low (~2019-2020 wind=44/41 vs gas_low ~44-45)
ax1.annotate('Wind crosses below\ncheapest new gas (2020)',
             xy=(2020, 41), xytext=(2022.5, 120),
             fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color=ANNOT_COLOR,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=ANNOT_COLOR, lw=1.3),
             ha='center', zorder=10,
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#EEF5FF', edgecolor=ANNOT_COLOR, alpha=0.9))

# Solar crosses below gas CCGT low (~2018-2019 solar=60/50 vs gas_low ~44-45 → 2019)
ax1.annotate('Solar below cheapest\nnew gas (2019)',
             xy=(2019, 50), xytext=(2016.5, 30),
             fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color=ANNOT_COLOR,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=ANNOT_COLOR, lw=1.3),
             ha='center', zorder=10,
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FFF5EE', edgecolor=ANNOT_COLOR, alpha=0.9))

# Battery cost collapse annotation
ax1.annotate(f'Battery: –91%\n$1,100 → $102/MWh',
             xy=(2024, 102), xytext=(2022.5, 550),
             fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color=COL_BATTERY,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=COL_BATTERY, lw=1.3),
             ha='center', zorder=10,
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#F8EEF8', edgecolor=COL_BATTERY, alpha=0.9))

# Solar cost decline annotation
ax1.annotate(f'Solar PV: –91%\n$359 → $33/MWh',
             xy=(2024, 33), xytext=(2023.2, 15),
             fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', color=COL_SOLAR,
             ha='center', zorder=10,
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FFF5EE', edgecolor=COL_SOLAR, alpha=0.9))

ax1.set_yticks([30, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1100])
ax1.get_yaxis().set_major_formatter(mticker.ScalarFormatter())
ax1.set_ylabel('LCOE (USD/MWh, 2023 real $)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('')
ax1.set_xlim(2009.5, 2024.8)
ax1.set_ylim(20, 1500)
ax1.set_title('A.  Levelized Cost of Energy — Renewables vs. Fossil Fuels',
              fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=10)

legend1 = ax1.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=8, frameon=True, framealpha=0.9,
                      edgecolor='#CCCCCC', fancybox=True)
legend1.get_frame().set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)

ax1.text(0.01, 0.02, 'Log scale', transform=ax1.transAxes, fontsize=7,
         color='#999999', style='italic')

# ===== PANEL B: Installed Capacity (bottom-left) =====
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])

ax2.fill_between(years_cap, 0, solar_cap, alpha=0.25, color=COL_SOLAR_CAP, zorder=2)
ax2.fill_between(years_cap, 0, wind_cap, alpha=0.2, color=COL_WIND_CAP, zorder=1)
ax2.plot(years_cap, solar_cap, color=COL_SOLAR_CAP, linewidth=2.5, marker='s', markersize=4,
         label='Solar PV', zorder=4)
ax2.plot(years_cap, wind_cap, color=COL_WIND_CAP, linewidth=2.5, marker='^', markersize=4,
         label='Onshore Wind', zorder=3)

# Annotate acceleration post-2018
ax2.axvline(x=2018, color='#999999', linestyle=':', linewidth=1, alpha=0.7)
ax2.annotate('Solar acceleration\npost-2018',
             xy=(2018, 512), xytext=(2013.5, 1400),

             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FFF5EE', edgecolor=COL_SOLAR, alpha=0.9))

# Annotate final values
ax2.text(2024.2, 1950, f'1,950 GW', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color=COL_SOLAR,
         va='center')
ax2.text(2024.2, 960, f'960 GW', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color=COL_WIND,

ax2.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_xlim(2009.5, 2025.5)
